nodes.label: SYSTEM.md: how GLUE works now
nodes.rationale: Complete description of how GLUE works today: pieces, GLUE folder, profiles, collections, GLUE Home, analysis, GLUE Cloud, website layout

nodes.label: GLUE architecture: website, GLUE folder, GLUE Home, GLUE Cloud
nodes.rationale: Four-piece architecture: browser website (Svelte 5, TypeScript, GitHub Pages), local GLUE folder (JSON files), GLUE Home (Tauri 2 tray app, Rust engine), GLUE Cloud (Cloudflare Worker with D1 and Durable Object)

nodes.label: Website
nodes.rationale: Svelte 5 + TypeScript app on GitHub Pages, works offline without account, all local by default

nodes.label: GLUE folder
nodes.rationale: User's data: JSON files (no database), chosen on first run or kept in browser storage (OPFS) on devices without a folder

nodes.label: GLUE Home
nodes.rationale: Tauri 2 tray app on Windows and macOS; when running, is the library's engine and website on that computer is its screen

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud
nodes.rationale: Optional account service: Cloudflare Worker with D1 database and Durable Object for signaling, holds account's collections (never music), profiles and devices

nodes.label: How a computer uses GLUE
nodes.rationale: Four modes: just this computer (local only), synced (account, cloud sync), with GLUE Home (streams songs to other devices, analyses, writes), another device (sign in only)

nodes.label: Music folders
nodes.rationale: Roots in collections with file handles (live in IndexedDB or GLUE Home finds them); can be on local drives or network (treated as away, not gone, when unreachable)

nodes.label: Analysis system
nodes.rationale: Summary (verdict, tier, bandwidth, bit depth, BPM, key), full details, fingerprint, mini spectrogram, waveform; runs in GLUE Home natively (Rust, glue-audio) or in browser worker pool

nodes.label: Shared collections
nodes.rationale: Signed in with cloud sync on, every collection is the account's in shared form: one copy in GLUE Cloud snapshot and log; each device has one id; sync merges per field, computer's own side wins for per-computer parts

nodes.label: Home mode operation
nodes.rationale: With GLUE Home running, website uses GLUE Home's disk over local link, starts no library work of its own (sync, analysis, backups, repairs); tab is only GLUE Home's screen

nodes.label: Local link (http://127.0.0.1:47400-47409)
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home's HTTP endpoints: /hello (identity), /connect (token), /fs (disk), /cache (analyses), /rpc (Rust engine), /lease, /attach, /incoming, /dock, /folders

nodes.label: GLUE Home engine (Rust)
nodes.rationale: Central Rust engine (crates/glue-engine): one store per collection, applies tab edits, saves, feeds changes back; jobs continue after restart; service (status, timers, backups, updates, reminders)

nodes.label: GLUE Home analysis queue
nodes.rationale: One pipeline inside songs at a time: requested songs, new songs' tags, library songs, background thumbnails; counted in window's meter; passed failures retried, not stored; third try saves as failed

nodes.label: Shared sync (GLUE Home Rust port)
nodes.rationale: GLUE Cloud keeps snapshot and log; push is one log entry on latest revision, else pull-merge-push; only changed files; merge3 per field; clashes wait in box; computer never clashes with itself

nodes.label: Library store in Rust
nodes.rationale: crates/glue-store: CollectionStore, shared projections, repair; ported line for line with JavaScript JSON rules; held byte for byte by tests/golden/store

nodes.label: Streaming over WebRTC
nodes.rationale: Data channels between website and GLUE Home, direct (LAN/internet) or through TURN relay; stream by byte range; Service Worker turns remote URLs into Range responses for normal audio elements

nodes.label: Signaling Durable Object
nodes.rationale: Per-user room in GLUE Cloud: presence, broadcasts to account devices (shared, profiles, gone), WebRTC signals; TURN relay credentials from /v1/turn

nodes.label: GLUE Home connections in Rust
nodes.rationale: crates/glue-rtc (webrtc-rs): peer connections, channels, pings, uploads, cache files, song bytes sent/received; all coordinated on one thread in order

nodes.label: Library answers from engine
nodes.rationale: crates/glue-engine/answers.rs, covers.rs, incoming.rs: engine answers requests (data, bytes, song file from disk); messages up to 256 KB

nodes.label: Sessions (per device's tab with GLUE Home)
nodes.rationale: Each tab keeps one session per account device, opened at sign-in, kept alive with ping every 15 s; max 5 at once; refuses when full; disconnected tab refused for an hour

nodes.label: Analysis version tracking
nodes.rationale: ANALYSIS_VERSION 3, VERDICT_VERSION 8; rule change bumps version; stored verdicts judged again on open (recheckVerdicts)

nodes.label: Native analysis engine (glue-audio)
nodes.rationale: crates/glue-audio: same analysis in Rust, line-for-line port with JavaScript numbers; GLUE Home since 0.44; DSD analysed as 88.2 kHz PCM; held to TypeScript results by tests/golden

hyperedges.label: GLUE sync pipeline: shared form with snapshot and log in cloud, merge per field on tab or GLUE Home, clashes never from same computer
GLUE Home distributed analysis: native Rust engine applies edits and queues analysis, streams results to other devices
